title: Chapter frontmatter
description: Metadata carried in the YAML frontmatter of a chapter file under chapters/. The body stays pure Markdown prose.

id.description: Chapter id, format vVV-cCCC zero-padded, e.g. v01-c003.

word_count.description: Word/character count of the prose body.

state_after.description: git commit hash of the .novel/state/ snapshot after this chapter was written. Ties prose to its referenced state (principle 2).

foreshadow_planted.description: Foreshadow ids planted in this chapter.

foreshadow_resolved.description: Foreshadow ids resolved in this chapter.

status.description: draft = just written; reviewed = passed review; final = locked.

scene_types.description: Primary scene types in this chapter — drives which style benchmark samples to inject.
